_why: Raw captures from Assets/screenshots v2.0 carry four classes of thing that cannot ship on a public marketing page: (1) win/loss framing, which the brand rules forbid outright, (2) the BETA / TEST MODE bar, (3) the support chat bubble sitting on top of real content, and (4) literal test-tenant strings. Each op below removes one named instance. Coordinates are fractions of the source image so the recipe survives a recapture at another size. Prefer `clone` over `redact`: a flat averaged patch is visible against any surface carrying a gradient or a hairline, and every one of these captures has both.

items._src_note: Catalogue id 04. The strongest supplier frame in the library: real Find a Tender notices (NHS Lancashire and South Cumbria Adult Teledermatology, North Ayrshire Council Community Support) with values, CPV and NUTS codes. No win/loss language anywhere on the screen.
